## title: "CV"

# Curriculum Vitae

## Current Position

### PhD Candidate in Ecology

**Estacion Biologica de Donana (CSIC), Spain**
*2022–present*

Research focused on plant-pollinator interaction networks, ecological networks, climate change, and biodiversity conservation. Current projects include phenological shifts in Mediterranean communities, land-use gradients and pollinator networks, and the development of European-scale probabilistic interaction networks.

Expected thesis completion: January 2027.
